blurb: SwiftFish Charters offers private fishing charters in Tampa Bay targeting species like redfish, snook, trout, and more. They provide all fishing gear and local knowledge, catering to families, beginners, and experienced anglers. Additional outdoor adventures include duck hunting and scalloping charters based out of Homosassa.
extraNote: All trips are private charters · Waders available to rent for duck hunting · Inshore fishing available throughout much of the year; duck hunting Sept 18-22, Sept 23-26, Nov 20-28, Dec 11-Jan 30
